# 2nd University Partners Summit (UPS) Beihang

The 2nd University Partners Summit of Beihang University was held at the university's Hangzhou International Campus on October 22, bringing together more than 230 experts and scholars from over 130 universities and research institutes across 50 countries and regions.

![](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/__local/1/4F/D3/0396A2094E4AFFF7ECD9BB8AD0A_3707406E_15057.jpg)

The summit, with the theme "Building Inclusive, Innovative, and Collaborative Sustainable Partnerships," serves as a platform to strengthen consensus and expand international collaboration in higher education and scientific research.

![](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/__local/4/B7/9F/59AA4016F7977CB2CAA75F1A10B_A4FFFAD0_29942.jpg)

Prior to the opening ceremony, President Wang Yunpeng met with 18 university leaders and international experts from Spain, Brazil, Mexico, the Macao and Hong Kong SARs of China, and other countries and regions. The distinguished guests included: Im Sio Kei, Rector of Macao Polytechnic University; Javier Uceda, former Rector of Polytechnic University of Madrid (UPM); Jiang Hui, Secretary-General of the Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Organization (APSCO); João Ramos Torres de Mello Neto, Vice Rector of Federal University of Rio de Janeiro; Gwenaëlle Guillerme, Secretary-General of the T.I.M.E. Association; José Manuel Páez, former Vice Rector of Tecnológico de Monterrey and UPM; In Han Song, Vice President of Yonsei University; Jacques Mick, Vice President of Federal University of Santa Catarina; Dong Cheng, Associate Vice President of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; Ayub Gitau, Vice Chancellor of the University of Nairobi; Julio Romano Meneghini, Member of the Brazilian Academy of Sciences and Professor at the University of São Paulo; Wang Lihui, Member of the Canadian Academy of Engineering and Professor at KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Maciej Ogorzalek, Member of the European Academy of Sciences and Professor at Jagiellonian University; Anibal Ollero Baturone, Member of the Royal Academy of Engineering of Spain and Professor at the University of Seville; and Enrico Zio, Professor at the Polytechnic University of Milan and former President of the European Safety and Reliability Association (ESRA).


![Wang Yunpeng meets with distinguished guests](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/__local/C/2B/C2/73633871AE0B98263F69AD33164_DF6D72CF_19250.jpg)


Wang Yunpeng expressed his warm welcome and sincere gratitude for their long-standing trust and support. He noted that as Beihang celebrates its 73rd anniversary, the university remains committed to the principles of "Inclusion, Innovation, and Collaboration," which have fostered a conducive environment for achievements in talent development, scientific research, and international cooperation. He hoped that the summit would serve as a platform to build a high-quality, sustainable international cooperation network and innovate models for global educational collaboration.

The opening ceremony on the morning of October 22 was held at the Conference Center of Hangzhou International Campus. It was attended by Wang Yunpeng, along with Zheng Kai, a second-level inspector at the Department of International Cooperation of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), Yu Yun, a second-level inspector at the Department of Human Resource and Social Security of Zhejiang Province, and Xu Junmin, Deputy Director of the Foreign Affairs Office of the Hangzhou Municipal People's Government. The ceremony was presided over by Zhao Weisheng, Vice President of Beihang University.

![](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/__local/F/C4/65/12F4B678C7225BD153EFB6B30E9_B5CD20FF_1EBA0.jpg)

Parallel events included country-focused sessions on Spain and Brazil, such as the UPM Day at Beihang University and the 2nd Beihang Brazil Innovation Forum, which facilitated in-depth academic exchanges and partnership building. A total of 18 thematic academic sessions were held, spanning cutting-edge fields like artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, aerospace, and sustainable energy.

The 2nd Beihang Brazil Innovation Forum gathered over 50 professors from 11 Brazilian institutions. Multiple cooperation agreements were signed, and 10 renowned Brazilian scholars were appointed as adjunct professors.

Dong Zhuoning, Assistant President and Dean of the Hangzhou International Innovation Institute at Beihang University, signs an agreement with the Federal University of Mato Grosso do Sul and presents Visiting Professor Certificates to distinguished Brazilian scholars.

The summit was held as an official parallel session of the 23rd Conference on International Exchange of Professionals, whose opening ceremony took place at the Shanghai World Expo Center on October 21. During the conference, Beihang signed a talent exchange agreement with the Brazilian Institute of Pure and Applied Mathematics (IMPA). Under this agreement, the two institutions will establish the "China-Brazil Mathematics Laboratory" at Beihang University to advance comprehensive collaboration in talent exchanges, scientific research, and education across multiple fields including pure mathematics, applied mathematics, data science, and artificial intelligence.

![](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/__local/A/36/D7/773B3226D9641C3E36171E74F05_CDEAA8F3_167C0.jpg)

The summit marks a significant milestone in Beihang's efforts to deepen global collaboration and exemplifies the openness of Chinese higher education. Leveraging the advantages of its Hangzhou International Campus, Beihang is injecting Chinese wisdom into the global network of scientific and educational cooperation.

Source: October 25, 2025 [https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/info/1022/2614.htm](https://ev.buaa.edu.cn/info/1022/2614.htm)
